messages:
katie: heads-up i opened a quick PR to harmonize the function-calling examples and add a tiny migration snippet for older envelopes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4499 :memo:

omar: awesome. do we standardize on the compact invoke signature (invoke({tool, input}) -> {result}) or keep the longer envelope in examples?

katie: compact by default. include a short appendix titled 'Legacy envelope shim' showing a normalize helper. keeps the main examples clean for new users.

ryan: saw a couple of references to `tools[].output_schema` in codegen docs that should be `tools[].response_schema`. i'll patch those in a follow-up PR, but katie, your PR should reference the canonical field name.

katie: thanks ryan. i'll update the snippets. proposed shim:

```js
function normalizeInvoke(resp) {
  // handle new compact, old envelope, and nested output.result
  return resp.result ?? resp.response?.result ?? resp.output?.result ?? resp.output ?? null;
}
```

omar: tiny nit: prefer explicit checks rather than `??` chain in the docs example so readers see the cases. maybe show both compact and defensive patterns.

katie: good call. i'll split into "Preferred (compact)" and "Defensive (compat)".

docs-bot: docs-ci/lint -> PR 4499: 1 broken link (structured-output path), 1 codeblock lint warning in docs/structured-output.md:line 120.

ryan: i'll get the schema rename PR up in ~15m and include a changelog entry. once that's merged, katie you can rebase and fix the link.

omar: i'm available to run a quick TS smoke test against staging for the TS snippet. leave a comment when you're ready.

katie: timeline: aiming to merge today so examples are clean for the next SDK release. i'll ping when PR is updated after the rename. thanks! :rocket:
